title: Storyboard
description: The contract between every pipeline stage. Prompts, seeds and durations live here, not in code.

languages.description: Narration languages. The first is the primary language.

voice.description: The narrator. A stock text-to-speech voice, never a copy of a real person's voice.

name.description: A prebuilt voice name of the text-to-speech model.

style.description: How the lines are spoken, in a few words.

style_block.description: Appended to every image prompt. Describes qualities; never names a living artist.

world_block.description: Who and where. Added to every picture prompt: the people (how they look and dress), the buildings, the land, the crops and the era, so pictures show the story's real setting and not a generic one.

reference_sheet.description: The character and style reference generated before any keyframe.

caption.description: Style, mood, instruments, texture, era. Tempo and key go in their own fields.

chosen_seed.description: The candidate picked by the director. Absent until the audition is done.

text.description: Must state that the film was made with AI.

use_reference.description: Whether the picture is painted with the reference sheet as a guide image. Wide landscapes copy the sheet's composition when guided, so they rely on the style block alone.

motion_mode.description: video = image-to-video model; ken_burns = pan and zoom over the keyframe; still = hold.

motion_prompt.description: Motion and camera only. Do not re-describe the subject.

narration.description: One line per language code. An empty string means the shot has no narration.

reason.description: Why this shot exists, in terms of the audience and the intended feeling.

fact_ids.description: Ids of the researched facts this shot's narration relies on.
